title: THE DANGEROUS WARNING OF THE FIG TREE—DON’T WAIT UNTIL IT’S TOO LATE!
paragraphs: THE DANGEROUS WARNING OF THE FIG TREE—DON’T WAIT UNTIL IT’S TOO LATE!

A WARNING YOU CANNOT IGNORE!
💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, why did Jesus curse the fig tree? What does it mean for us today?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people read this story and think it’s just about a tree—but Jesus was sending a powerful warning to every believer.
🚨 THE MESSAGE IS CLEAR: IF YOU DO NOT PRODUCE FRUIT, YOU WILL BE CUT OFF!

📖 Luke 13:6-9 (KJV)
"He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none. Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?"
💡 Jesus is warning us: Are you truly bearing fruit, or are you just taking up space?

🔥 TODAY, WE WILL UNCOVER:
✔️ Why Jesus cursed the fig tree and what it represents
✔️ The spiritual danger of being ‘unfruitful’ in God’s Kingdom
✔️ How many Christians THINK they are saved—but are actually in danger of being cut off!
🚨 The truth may shock you—but you cannot ignore it!

THE TRUTH REVEALED – WHY DID JESUS CURSE THE FIG TREE?
📖 Mark 11:12-14 (KJV)
"And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find anything thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet. And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter forever. And his disciples heard it."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
At first, this might seem like an unusual act—why would Jesus curse a tree just because it had no fruit? But this was not just about a tree—this was a prophetic message about Israel and about all believers!

✅ 1. THE FIG TREE REPRESENTS ISRAEL—AND ALL WHO CLAIM TO FOLLOW GOD!
All throughout Scripture, the fig tree was used as a symbol of Israel and God's people.

📖 Hosea 9:10 (KJV)
"I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the first ripe in the fig tree at her first time..."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ The tree LOOKED healthy on the outside—but had NO FRUIT!
✔️ Israel had religion, traditions, and rituals—but they had NO REAL RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD!
✔️ Many Christians today LOOK saved—but their lives are spiritually empty!
🚨 THE WARNING: Just like the fig tree, MANY people appear to be alive in faith but have NO FRUIT to prove it!
💡 QUESTION: Is your faith producing fruit—or are you just going through the motions?

✅ 2. HAVING LEAVES BUT NO FRUIT—THE DANGER OF RELIGIOUS HYPOCRISY!
The tree had green leaves, which made it LOOK like it had fruit—but when Jesus inspected it, there was nothing!

📖 Matthew 23:27 (KJV)
"Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Some people LOOK holy—but inside, they are spiritually dead!
✔️ Going to church, quoting Scripture, and looking "Christian" is NOT enough!
✔️ Jesus is not fooled by appearances—He is looking for REAL FRUIT!
🚨 THE WARNING: If your faith is all show but has no substance, you are in danger of being cut off!
💡 QUESTION: Is your life truly bearing fruit for God, or are you just putting on a religious show?

✅ 3. MANY PEOPLE THINK THEY HAVE TIME—BUT JESUS’ JUDGMENT IS SUDDEN!
Many people believe they can wait before they get serious with God. But notice—Jesus cursed the tree immediately!

📖 Luke 13:7 (KJV)
"Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?"

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ God has been patient with you—but time is running out!
✔️ If you are not producing fruit, you are WASTING your time and space in the Kingdom!
✔️ Judgment will not come with a warning—it will be SUDDEN and FINAL!
🚨 THE WARNING: Jesus cursed the fig tree immediately—what if today is your last chance to repent?
💡 QUESTION: What if Jesus comes back TODAY—would He find fruit in your life?

✅ 4. WHY DID JESUS GET ANGRY? BECAUSE THE TREE WAS PRETENDING TO BE FRUITFUL!
This fig tree had leaves, which means it was giving the impression that it had fruit—but it was a lie!

📖 Titus 1:16 (KJV)
"They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Some people claim to follow God—but their actions prove otherwise!
✔️ They talk about faith—but they have no obedience!
✔️ They claim to love Jesus—but they live in sin!
🚨 THE WARNING: God does not judge based on what we SAY—but on what we PRODUCE!
💡 QUESTION: Does your life prove that you truly belong to Jesus?

✅ 5. JESUS IS STILL INSPECTING HIS CHURCH TODAY—WILL HE FIND FRUIT?
The same way Jesus inspected the fig tree, He is inspecting the church today!

📖 Revelation 3:15-16 (KJV)
"I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot. So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Lukewarm Christians are just as useless as an unfruitful fig tree!
✔️ If you are not fully surrendered to God, you are in danger!
✔️ God does not accept halfway commitment—you are either producing fruit or you are being rejected!
🚨 THE WARNING: If your faith is dead, you will be cut off—just like the fig tree!
💡 QUESTION: Will Jesus find you faithful—or will He reject you for being lukewarm?

✅ 6. GOD IS GIVING YOU TIME—BUT THE AXE IS READY!
In another parable, Jesus explained that God is patient—but there is a limit!

📖 Luke 13:6-9 (KJV)
"He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none. Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground? And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it: And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ God is giving you a chance to repent—but not forever!
✔️ Every time you hear the truth, God is "digging around" your heart, calling you to bear fruit.
✔️ If you refuse to change, you will be CUT DOWN!
🚨 THE WARNING: If you keep ignoring God's warnings, the day will come when He says, "ENOUGH!"
💡 QUESTION: How much longer will you wait before you start bearing fruit?

✅ 7. MANY THINK THEY ARE SAVED—BUT JESUS WILL REJECT THEM!
A lot of people call themselves Christians, but their lives prove otherwise.

📖 Matthew 7:19-20 (KJV)
"Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire. Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ If your life does not produce real evidence of faith, you are in danger!
✔️ Jesus is not looking for empty words—He is looking for obedience!
✔️ Fake Christians will be "hewn down" (cut down) and cast into the fire!
🚨 THE WARNING: Many will be shocked on Judgment Day when Jesus says, "I NEVER KNEW YOU!"
💡 QUESTION: Will your life PROVE that you belong to Christ—or will you be cast into the fire?

✅ 8. JUDGMENT DAY IS COMING—DON’T WAIT UNTIL IT’S TOO LATE!
Just like the fig tree was judged, everyone will stand before Jesus one day.

📖 2 Corinthians 5:10 (KJV)
"For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Everyone will give an account of what they did with their life.
✔️ Excuses will NOT be accepted!
✔️ You either produce fruit for God—or you are cast out!
🚨 THE WARNING: Time is running out! The axe is at the root of the tree—if you do not repent NOW, you may not get another chance!
💡 QUESTION: Are you ready to stand before God—or will you be found unfruitful?

THE TERRIFYING FATE OF THE UNFRUITFUL!
Many people believe that as long as they believe in God, they will be fine. But Jesus makes it clear: If you do not bear fruit, you will be cut down and cast into the fire!

📖 Matthew 3:10 (KJV)
"And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Jesus is not waiting until later—THE AXE IS ALREADY AT THE ROOT!
✔️ You are either growing in Christ or you are one step away from judgment!
✔️ Hell is not just for unbelievers—it is also for those who claimed to know God but produced no fruit!
🚨 THE WARNING: If your life does not show obedience to Christ, you are already marked for destruction!
💡 QUESTION: Is Jesus ready to "cut you down," or is He pleased with the fruit in your life?

✅ 1. JESUS COMPARED THE UNFRUITFUL TO WORTHLESS BRANCHES DESTINED FOR FIRE!
📖 John 15:5-6 (KJV)
"I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing. If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ You cannot bear fruit on your own—only through Jesus!
✔️ If you do not remain in Him, you will dry up and be thrown into the fire!
✔️ The fire Jesus speaks about is ETERNAL HELLFIRE!
🚨 THE WARNING: Many people will be shocked on Judgment Day when Jesus says, "Depart from Me!"
💡 QUESTION: Are you truly connected to Jesus, or are you a dried-up branch waiting to be burned?

✅ 2. MANY CHRISTIANS WILL BE REJECTED BECAUSE THEY WERE FRUITLESS!
📖 Matthew 7:22-23 (KJV)
"Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works? And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Good works do NOT save you—only obedience does!
✔️ You can preach, heal, and cast out demons—but if you don’t produce real fruit, Jesus will reject you!
✔️ You can claim Jesus’ name, but if He doesn’t know you, YOU ARE LOST!
🚨 THE WARNING: Just because you say "Lord, Lord" does NOT mean you belong to Him!
💡 QUESTION: Does Jesus KNOW you, or will He reject you for being fruitless?

✅ 3. THE FINAL DESTINY OF THE FRUITLESS IS HELLFIRE!
📖 Revelation 20:15 (KJV)
"And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ If your life has no proof of true salvation, your name will NOT be in the Book of Life!
✔️ No second chances, no excuses—JESUS WILL CAST YOU INTO ETERNAL FIRE!
✔️ Being "Christian" in name only will not save you—you must be born again and bear fruit!
🚨 THE WARNING: Many churchgoers are on their way to hell because they have no fruit to prove they belong to Jesus!
💡 QUESTION: Is your name in the Book of Life, or are you just assuming you are saved?

✅ 4. THE SCARIEST WORDS YOU COULD EVER HEAR FROM JESUS!
Imagine standing before Jesus, expecting to enter Heaven—but instead, He REJECTS you!

📖 Matthew 7:22-23 (KJV)
"Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works? And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ You can preach, heal, and do miracles—and still be rejected by Jesus!
✔️ Calling Jesus "Lord" does NOT mean you belong to Him!
✔️ Only those who OBEY and BEAR FRUIT will enter the Kingdom of Heaven!
🚨 THE WARNING: There will be many "Christians" in hell because they had NO REAL RELATIONSHIP with Jesus!
💡 QUESTION: Does Jesus KNOW you, or will He reject you?

✅ 5. YOU CANNOT HIDE FROM GOD—HE SEES THE FRUIT OR THE LACK OF IT!
Many people try to fake their faith—but God is not fooled!

📖 Hebrews 4:13 (KJV)
"Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ You might fool your pastor, your friends, and your church—but you CAN'T fool Jesus!
✔️ You are either producing the fruit of righteousness—or the fruit of sin!
✔️ Everything will be revealed on Judgment Day—there are NO SECRETS before God!
🚨 THE WARNING: If you are hiding sin, pretending to be a Christian, or ignoring God’s commands, Jesus sees it all!
💡 QUESTION: What does Jesus see when He looks at YOUR life?

✅ 6. LIVING A DOUBLE LIFE WILL LEAD TO DAMNATION!
There are people who act like Christians in church but live like the world in private. Jesus called them lukewarm—and He said He will SPIT THEM OUT!

📖 Revelation 3:15-16 (KJV)
"I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot. So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Lukewarm Christians are DISGUSTING to God!
✔️ You are either ON FIRE for Jesus—or you are against Him!
✔️ Being ‘halfway committed’ to God is the same as rejecting Him!
🚨 THE WARNING: Jesus doesn’t accept part-time believers—either you are His or you are not!
💡 QUESTION: Are you hot, cold, or lukewarm? Be honest—where do you really stand?

✅ 7. THE FINAL DESTINY OF THE FRUITLESS IS HELLFIRE!
Jesus didn’t say He would "discipline" the unfruitful tree—He said He would CUT IT DOWN!

📖 Revelation 20:15 (KJV)
"And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ If your life has no proof of true salvation, your name will NOT be in the Book of Life!
✔️ No second chances, no excuses—JESUS WILL CAST YOU INTO ETERNAL FIRE!
✔️ Being "Christian" in name only will not save you—you must be born again and bear fruit!
🚨 THE WARNING: Many churchgoers are on their way to hell because they have no fruit to prove they belong to Jesus!
💡 QUESTION: Is your name in the Book of Life, or are you just assuming you are saved?

THE FINAL WARNING – YOU CANNOT STAY NEUTRAL!
Jesus has made it clear: If you do not bear fruit, you will be cut down and cast into the fire!

🚨 THERE ARE ONLY TWO OPTIONS:
✔️ Repent, obey Jesus, and bear fruit
❌ Ignore this message and face eternal judgment

📖 Galatians 6:7-8 (KJV)
"Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap. For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ If you live for yourself, you will reap DESTRUCTION!
✔️ If you live for Christ, you will reap ETERNAL LIFE!
✔️ You cannot fool God—your fruit will prove where you belong!
🚨 THE WARNING: Time is running out—JESUS IS COMING SOON!
💡 QUESTION: What will your life prove on Judgment Day?

🚨 JESUS WILL REJECT MANY WHO THOUGHT THEY WERE SAVED!
📖 Luke 13:24-27 (KJV)
"Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able. When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are: Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets. But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity."

🚨 THINK ABOUT THIS:
❌ These people THOUGHT they were saved—but Jesus shut the door on them!
❌ They knew ABOUT Jesus—but Jesus did not KNOW them!
❌ They wanted salvation—but they waited TOO LATE!

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ You must truly belong to Jesus—not just be "around" Christianity!
✔️ You cannot wait until it’s too late—TODAY is the day of salvation!
✔️ There is no second chance after death—your decision is FINAL!
🚨 THE WARNING: Once the door is shut, it will NEVER open again!
💡 QUESTION: Will Jesus open the door for you, or will He say, "I never knew you"?

🔥 THIS MAY BE YOUR LAST WARNING!
The truth has been spoken. You cannot unread this or pretend you never heard it.

🚨 WHAT WILL YOU DO NOW?
❌ Ignore it and stay in deception?
✔️ Repent, obey Jesus, and truly become part of God’s family?

📖 Hebrews 3:15 (KJV)
"While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation."
🔥 THIS MAY BE YOUR LAST CHANCE TO CHOOSE!

⚔️ JOIN THE GOSPEL WARRIORS MOVEMENT!

I choose to bear good fruit, to live in obedience, and to follow You with my whole heart. Remove all spiritual deception from my life, and fill me with the Holy Spirit so that I may walk in truth.
